description: Test file for nftables helper functions in Kubernetes proxy, including transaction sorting, diffing, chain diffing, and packet tracing tests for both IPv4 and IPv6 configurations.

classes.name: nftablesTracer
classes.description: Struct used for tracing packet flow through nftables rules for testing purposes.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Returns a string with the caller's file and line number for debugging.

methods.name: sortNFTablesTransaction
methods.description: Sorts nftables transaction string into a standard order for comparison.

methods.name: diffNFTablesTransaction
methods.description: Diffs two nftables transaction strings after sorting, for testing equality.

methods.name: assertNFTablesTransactionEqual
methods.description: Asserts that two nftables transaction strings are equal, reports diff if not.

methods.name: diffNFTablesChain
methods.description: Diffs the rules in a specific chain of a fake nftables table.

methods.name: runPacketFlowTests
methods.description: Runs a series of packet flow tests to verify nftables rule behavior.
